dedupe_keys.name: barra2 dl barra2 point series retrieval tool

description: barra2-dl retrieves selected variables from the BARRA2 atmospheric reanalysis for a chosen latitude, longitude and time interval. Richard Gledhill provides Python functions that assemble monthly NetCDF Subset Service requests and collect point CSV outputs from the NCI THREDDS server. The repository documents wind-resource assessment as the initial use, with other meteorological variables also available. Coverage follows BARRA2 over Australia and surrounding regions, beginning in 1979; implemented one-hour products include AUS-11 and AUST-04. The selected series represents the closest model grid node, not a measurement at the exact requested location. Code is public and free under CC BY 4.0, and the README also identifies CC BY 4.0 for the source reanalysis. A limitation is that bulk gridded NetCDF download, multiple-location operation and a command-line interface are still listed as future work. Simulation uses include constructing weather inputs for renewable-energy assessment and comparing reanalysis-driven scenarios. It relates to data-era5-reanalysis as another reanalysis input source. The old repository address redirects to richard-gledhill/barra2-dl; no retrieval job was run.
